selection: Fixed before exp4 test inference: existing A+B 14000 updates, best training objective; no C, no teacher, no new training
secondary_subset: all valid test cases, including DS_ref <= 2 outside the training damage subset
representative_rule: For each test record and story count choose highest-PGA valid case at period_ratio=1.0, without inspecting prediction errors
acceptance: No numerical engineering acceptance threshold has been agreed; report MSE, complete curves and peak/damage errors without declaring an automatic pass
